name: openreading-local-documents
description: Select local documents and retrieve complete normalized content with exact evidence. Unsigned development preview.

interface.shortDescription: Local document tools with exact evidence
interface.longDescription: Select documents or folders for local processing through bundled Docling and automatic OCR. Retrieved content enters your assistant context. OCR can misread text. Local copies and exports persist until removed. Unsigned development preview; clean-machine and ordinary Chat acceptance remain pending. No token savings claim. OpenReading Managed: Coming soon. Document processing on OpenReading’s servers, without managing local compute. Planned after the public OSS launch.
defaultPrompt: Use OpenReading to choose local documents and quote their extracted text with exact evidence.
